empty.title: Nothing deployed yet
empty.description: Each deployment of this service is listed here with its full output.

trigger.title: Deployment trigger
trigger.description: A CI job, or anything else that can make a request, starts a deployment by calling this address with its token in an Authorization header.
trigger.forceRebuildHint: Add ?forceRebuild to skip the build cache and pull base images again.
trigger.rotateDescription: The current token stops working at once, so update your CI with the new one.
trigger.revokeDescription: Whoever holds it can no longer start a deployment. This cannot be undone: you would have to issue a new one.
trigger.tokenShownOnce: This is the only time it is shown. Send it as: Authorization: Bearer <token>.
trigger.legacyUrl: This token dates from before tokens moved to a header, so its old address still works too. Replace it so that only the header does.
trigger.copyHint: Copy it now: it isn't shown again.
trigger.exampleHint: A request that starts a deployment with this trigger.

webhook.title: Push webhook
webhook.description: Your Git host calls this address after each push. A delivery counts only if it is signed with the webhook's own secret, and only pushes to the repository and branch it was issued for deploy, once each.
webhook.legacy: This webhook dates from before webhooks had a secret of their own. It keeps working at its old address, signed with the old token, until you rotate it.
webhook.pausedHint: The repository or branch changed, or the account that issued it lost access, so its deliveries are refused. Rotate its secret to resume.
webhook.rotateDescription: The current secret stops working at once. The webhook then follows the service's current repository and branch.
webhook.removeDescription: Deliveries to its address are refused from now on. Remove it at your Git host as well.
webhook.shownOnce: This is the only time it is shown. Paste it into your Git host's webhook settings, with the content type set to JSON.

pending.title: Waiting for a deployment
pending.description: What is saved here but not yet running. The next deployment applies it. Values of variables and files are not shown, because they can be secrets.
pending.unknown: Nothing can be compared yet: no deployment has recorded what it put in place.

refetches.image: A deployment also pulls the image again, so what its tag points to now comes with it.
refetches.code: A deployment also fetches and builds the code again, so what its branch points to now comes with it.
refetches.stack: A deployment also fetches the stack's images and code again.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Each successful deployment keeps its exact image and settings, so that the service can go back to it. Going back never pulls, builds or fetches anything.
versions.busy: Other work is in progress on this service
versions.changeKeptHint: This server keeps the newest {{keep}} versions of each service. An administrator changes it in Settings, General.

active.label: Active
active.reason: This is the version running now.

not_deployed.label: Not deployed
not_deployed.reason: The service is not deployed, so there is nothing to replace.

renamed.label: Other name
renamed.reason: Version {{number}} was deployed under another name, and what it ran was tied to it.

image_missing.label: Image gone
image_missing.reason: The image of version {{number}} is no longer on this server, and going back never pulls one.

image_altered.label: Tag changed
image_altered.reason: The tag keeping version {{number}} was changed or removed outside the panel, so what it names can't be trusted.

volumes_differ.label: Other volumes
volumes_differ.reason: Version {{number}} does not use the same volumes as what runs now, so it would not see the current data.

rollback.title: Go back to version {{number}}?
rollback.description: This puts the image and settings of that version back in service. It is recorded as a new attempt.
rollback.noChanges: The same settings as what runs now.
rollback.volumesStay: Volumes stay as they are: whatever was written since then is kept.
rollback.savedStays: Saved settings stay saved, and reach the service at the next deployment.
rollback.notUndone: Database content and application migrations are not undone. Variables and secrets go back to what they were at that version.
rollback.failed: Could not go back to version {{number}}
